'''Izby''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[barghest]]<ref name="Absolutely Everything" /> who was the loyal and protective pet of [[Gwellis Bagnoro]], an [[Onodone]] [[Forger (profession)|forger]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Takodana]], Izby and Bagnoro spent most of their time in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of [[Maz Kanata]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Izzy was puppeteered by [[Kain Francis]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].
